title: SHA-1 use via hashlib.sha1 (python) — review required
description: The python call hashlib.sha1 computes SHA-1, which is deprecated for security purposes (collision attacks are practical for well-funded attackers and improving). It is unacceptable for signatures or integrity of untrusted data. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use hashlib.sha256 for any security purpose. Keep SHA-1 only for compatibility shims and checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any hashlib.sha1 call regardless of purpose. Name-selected SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
